newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Arch started - analyst.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Arch started - analyst.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst Jeanine Oburchay said she initiated Bcoverage of Arch Communications Group Inc with an attractive rating.
-- "There is nothing sexy about the Arch story. This company is all about boringly solid, strong growth led by an exceptional management team," she said in a research note.
-- Shares were up 9/16 at 13 in midafternoon trading.
-- Oburchay also said she also initiated coverage of ProNet Inc with a neutral rating.
-- ProNet was up 5/8 at 8-1/2 in midafternoon trading.
